item.description: ### Fixed - **Every Claude background session is recognised, not only some.** Claude runs a background session in one of three ways, and Perch knew one. A session that started before Claude had a spare slot ready, or one Claude restarted after a crash, was not seen as Claude at all. With Perch's hooks it kept its row but lost track of its process: after a restart the row went on pointing at the process that had died. Without hooks it had no row. Perch now recognises all three, so the row follows the session across a restart and carries its `claude attach` command either way. - **A session opened with `claude --resume=<id>` or `claude -r<id>` is matched to the right conversation.** Perch read the session only from the spaced form, `--resume <id>`, and could also mistake the word `--resume` inside a prompt for the option.
